name: Julia
summary: High-level, dynamically typed language for technical computing built around multiple dispatch over a parametric type system, JIT-compiled through LLVM, with Lisp-style macros.

level_notes.1: No formal specification or standard; the Julia manual and Base reference document the behaviour of the reference implementation. Language changes are discussed in GitHub issues/PRs (no formal proposal series); NEWS.md is the release-notes record.
level_notes.0: The reference implementation JuliaLang/julia: femtolisp front end (src/julia-parser.scm, julia-syntax.scm) being replaced by JuliaSyntax.jl, C runtime in src/, type inference in Compiler/, Base in base/.
